summary: National Healthcare Corp. (NHC) filed an 8-K reporting completion of its $560 million cash acquisition of 35 skilled nursing and independent living facilities from National Health Investors (NHI) on July 1, 2026. The purchase was funded by borrowings under a credit facility from Bank of America and cash on hand. NHC previously leased these properties. The credit agreement was amended to increase the revolver from $50M to $75M. No premium percentage, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. The transaction eliminates the master lease structure, converting NHC from tenant to owner-operator. Watch for integration execution and potential deleveraging actions.
